title: பிரயாணம் மற்றும் இடமாற்ற தூரம் (Travel Distance Indication)
description: Lagna Lord in 3rd = short travels/neighbouring town; in 6th = inter-state; in 8th = short international; in 12th = overseas trans-continental journeys.

title: வரன் மற்றும் பயண திசை அறிதல் (Direction of Alliance & Journey)
description: Rasi directions: East (Rishabham, Dhanusu), South (Mithunam, Makaram), West (Katakam, Kumbam), North (Mesham, Simham, Kanni, Meenam). Direction indicated by Lagna/7th lord.
